title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय २०३

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि रौप्याचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरो याति सोमलोकं नरोत्तम ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi raupyācalamanuttamam ||
yatpradānānnaro yāti somalokaṃ narottama || 1 ||

items.text:
सहस्रेण पलानां तु उत्तमो रजताचलः ॥
पंचभिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तस्तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
sahasreṇa palānāṃ tu uttamo rajatācalaḥ ||
paṃcabhirmadhyamaḥ proktastadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 ||

items.text:
अशक्तो विंशतेरूर्ध्वं कारयेद्भक्तितः सदा ॥
विष्कंभपर्वतांस्तद्वत्तुरीयांशेन कल्पयेत् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
aśakto viṃśaterūrdhvaṃ kārayedbhaktitaḥ sadā ||
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvatturīyāṃśena kalpayet || 3 ||

items.text:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादींश्च नितंबोऽत्र हिरण्मयः ॥
राजतं स्याद्यदन्येषां सर्वं तदिह कांचनम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīṃśca nitaṃbo'tra hiraṇmayaḥ ||
rājataṃ syādyadanyeṣāṃ sarvaṃ tadiha kāṃcanam || 5 ||

items.text:
शेषं च पूर्ववत्कृत्वा होमजागरणादिकम् ॥
दद्यात्तद्वत्प्रभाते तु गुरवे रौप्यपर्वतम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatkṛtvā homajāgaraṇādikam ||
dadyāttadvatprabhāte tu gurave raupyaparvatam || 6 ||

items.text:
विष्कंभशैलानृत्विग्भ्यः पूजयेच्च विभूषणैः ॥
इमं मंत्रं पठन्दद्याद्दर्भपाणिर्विमत्सरः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
viṣkaṃbhaśailānṛtvigbhyaḥ pūjayecca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhandadyāddarbhapāṇirvimatsaraḥ || 7 ||

items.text:
पितॄणां वल्लभं यस्माच्छर्मदं शंकरस्य च ॥
रजतं पाहि तस्मान्नो घोरात्संसारसागरात् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ yasmāccharmadaṃ śaṃkarasya ca ||
rajataṃ pāhi tasmānno ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt || 8 ||

items.text:
इत्थं निवेश्य यो दद्याद्रजताचलमुत्तमम् ॥
गवामयुतदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
itthaṃ niveśya yo dadyādrajatācalamuttamam ||
gavāmayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 9 ||

items.text:
राजेश राजतगिरिं कनकोपलालीच्छन्नं प्रसन्नसलिले सहितं सरोभिः ॥
यच्छंति ये सुकृतिनो विरजो वि शोकं गच्छंति ते गतमला नृप सोमलोकम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
rājeśa rājatagiriṃ kanakopalālīcchannaṃ prasannasalile sahitaṃ sarobhiḥ ||
yacchaṃti ye sukṛtino virajo vi śokaṃ gacchaṃti te gatamalā nṛpa somalokam || 1 ||

items.h: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे रौप्याचलदानविधिवर्णनं नाम त्र्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ।। २०३ ।।

en_summary: Krishna gives the silver mountain (raupya-achala), by whose gift a person goes to the Moon's world. The best is of a thousand palas of silver, the middle five hundred and the least half that, and one who cannot afford it should make it of at least twenty, with devotion; the supporting mountains, Mandara and the others, are of silver, a quarter of the size, the world guardians of fine gold, and Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the others, with the mountain's slope in gold: what is silver in the other mountains is gold here. With the fire offering, vigil and the rest as before, at dawn the patron, holding darbha and free of envy, gives the silver mountain to his teacher and the supporting mountains to the priests, honouring them with ornaments, with the prayer: "Since silver is dear to the ancestors and brings joy to Shankara, protect us from the terrible ocean of rebirth." The giver gains the fruit of giving ten thousand cows and lives in the Moon's world, honoured by gandharvas, kinnaras and apsaras, until the dissolution; those who give the silver mountain covered with rows of golden stones and with clear lakes go, free of stain and sorrow, to the Moon's world.
